Explore historical data on top civil servants, governments, ministers, state secretaries and political advisors in Norway. The dashboard runs in your browser, so it can take up to half a minute to load the first time. The datasets, codebook and citation are on the [Data page](data.qmd). Disclaimer: The dashboard is currently being beta-tested, so errors in visualizations and statistics may occur.
